name: US Dollar Payment Token
oneLiner: USDPT is Western Union's Solana dollar stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank with U.S. Bank as reserve custodian for B2B agent settlement.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Western Union and Anchorage disclosures support the fiat-cash classification, but do not disclose current reserve assurance, custody allocation, reconciliation, or recovery terms for the deployment-wide issuance and redemption system; that risk boundary remains unresolved.

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDPT is a U.S. dollar stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank for Western Union's global payment and settlement network.

genius.notes: Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. is the OCC-chartered national trust bank issuing USDPT for Western Union. ADB explicitly states it expects to become a PPSI once the GENIUS Act becomes effective (Jan 18, 2027 at the latest). The issuerPathway is federal-qualified-nonbank because ADB holds an OCC national trust charter but is uninsured (no FDIC insurance required), placing it outside the IDI-subsidiary category and instead on the federal nonbank/OCC pathway. A 2022 OCC consent order for BSA/AML deficiencies was fully terminated by the OCC in August 2025; no active enforcement action exists as of the review date. No PPSI approval or application has been filed; the PPSI application framework remains in proposed rulemaking.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No PPSI approval, official PPSI application, or state-qualified approval has been located for USDPT or Anchorage Digital Bank. The PPSI application framework remains in proposed rulemaking. Anchorage has publicly stated it expects PPSI status once the GENIUS Act becomes effective, confirming issuer-announced-intent.

review.evidence: Western Union identifies Anchorage Digital Bank as issuer and publishes the official mint. At finalized slot 432540329, Solana RPC confirms Token-2022 mint authority, permanent delegate, pause authority, freeze authority, and metadata authorities remain live system-owned wallet addresses. Anchorage publishes monthly Big Four AICPA reserve examinations for USDPT, including the May 2026 report. The OCC's 30 April 2026 active-trust-bank list records Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. under national charter 25243, establishing prudential supervision of the issuing bank.

reserves.issuerOrObligor: Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. (issuer; reserves custodied at U.S. Bank)

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
reserveReview.rationale: Western Union states USDPT is redeemable 1:1 for U.S. dollars, and issuer Anchorage Digital Bank confirms federally regulated issuance, custody, settlement, and treasury management for the token launched on Solana on May 4, 2026. Neither party publishes an attestation or a reserve allocation across cash, bank deposits, Treasury bills, or other cash equivalents, so the reserve is recorded as one bounded U.S.-dollar basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer and distribution-partner launch statements of full U.S. dollar backing; no attested reserve breakdown is published
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The allocation across cash, bank deposits, Treasury bills, and other cash equivalents, plus any sub-custodian split, is undisclosed; no third-party attestation has been published for USDPT.
